chunks: And in it it is narrated that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He granted him authority over those who follow him from among men and jinn.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this teaching within the Shia doctrine of *al-wilayah al-takwiniyyah* (cosmic dominion), clarifying that Satan’s power is not inherent but derived from Allah’s permission and the believer’s voluntary submission. This distinction underscores the theological principle that while jinn and humans share this susceptibility, true believers retain agency to nullify his influence through conscious adherence to divine guidance.
